finding: After the stopped instance was started, getSerialPortOutput start=0 exposed only the current recovery boot. The prior boot containing exit status 141 was not retained by the provider API and cannot be recovered without reconstruction.
policy: Do not fabricate or reconstruct attempt-1 provider serial. Treat attempt 1 as failed, non-decision evidence. Require complete provider evidence for attempt 2 before deletion or Gate 0B acceptance.
